subtitles.zh: 说说那一刻吧。当时正值疫情高峰期。
subtitles.en: Tell me about that moment. Well, it was in the heart of the pandemic.

subtitles.zh: 通常颁奖在瑞典斯德哥尔摩举行。
subtitles.en: And normally it's done in Stockholm, Sweden.

subtitles.zh: 诺贝尔委员会说，我们会把奖送到你那里。

subtitles.zh: 在你的花园里颁发给你。

subtitles.zh: 第二天醒来，世界是否豁然开朗？

subtitles.zh: 还是感到责任重大？
subtitles.en: Or do you feel a weight of responsibility?

subtitles.en: If I'm honest, I mean, was so overwhelming.

subtitles.zh: 我投身科学从未想过获奖。
subtitles.en: I didn't go into science with any thoughts of winning prizes.

subtitles.zh: 说实话，我以前只希望能有份工作。
subtitles.en: Believe me, you know, I just hoped I could get a job someday.

subtitles.zh: 我丈夫说，你现在的主要工作是做科学大使。
subtitles.en: My husband said to me, Well, now your main job is being an ambassador for science.

subtitles.zh: 我想，我该怎么做？
subtitles.en: I thought, how do I do that?

subtitles.en: Being the face of a scientific revolution is a lot of pressure, even for Jennifer Doudna, a legend in biology, who helped her in CRISPR into a breakthrough method for altering DNA,

subtitles.zh: 从遗传病到气候变化，她应对各种挑战，并在这个过程中催生了数十家公司。
subtitles.en: tackling everything from genetic disease to climate change, and spawning dozens of companies in the process.

subtitles.zh: 但一些批评者认为这项技术尚未达到宣传的效果，更不用说伦理问题了。
subtitles.en: But some critics claim the tech hasn't lived up to its hype just yet, not to mention the ethical concerns.

subtitles.zh: 与此同时，电影对生物技术的描绘对基因编辑来说并非好的公关。
subtitles.en: At the same time, movie depictions of biotechnology have been exactly been great PR for gene editing.

subtitles.zh: 比人类更人性化是我们的座右铭。我撒了多少谎并不重要。
subtitles.en: More human than human is our motto. It didn't matter how much I lied.

subtitles.zh: 我真正的简历在我的细胞里。
subtitles.en: My real resume was in my cells.

subtitles.zh: 这就是你领取诺贝尔奖的地方。
subtitles.en: This is where you accepted the Nobel.

subtitles.zh: 是的，就在这儿。
subtitles.en: Yes. Like right here. Right here.

subtitles.zh: 说说那一刻吧。当时正值疫情高峰期。
subtitles.en: Tell me about that moment. Well, it was in the heart of the pandemic.

subtitles.zh: 通常颁奖在瑞典斯德哥尔摩举行。
subtitles.en: And normally it's done in Stockholm, Sweden.

subtitles.zh: 诺贝尔委员会说，我们会把奖送到你那里。
subtitles.en: And so the Nobel committee said, Well, we're going to send the Nobel to you.

subtitles.zh: 在你的花园里颁发给你。
subtitles.en: And we're going to give it to you in your garden.

subtitles.zh: 第二天醒来，世界是否豁然开朗？
subtitles.en: When you wake up the next day, does the world just open up?

subtitles.zh: 还是感到责任重大？
subtitles.en: Or do you feel a weight of responsibility?

subtitles.zh: 说实话，当时太震撼了。
subtitles.en: If I'm honest, I mean, was so overwhelming.

subtitles.zh: 我投身科学从未想过获奖。
subtitles.en: I didn't go into science with any thoughts of winning prizes.

subtitles.zh: 说实话，我以前只希望能有份工作。
subtitles.en: Believe me, you know, I just hoped I could get a job someday.

subtitles.zh: 我丈夫说，你现在的主要工作是做科学大使。
subtitles.en: My husband said to me, Well, now your main job is being an ambassador for science.

subtitles.zh: 我想，我该怎么做？
subtitles.en: I thought, how do I do that?

subtitles.zh: 作为科学革命的代言人压力很大，即使对生物学传奇人物詹妮弗·杜德纳也是如此，她帮助CRISPR成为改变DNA的突破性方法。
subtitles.en: Being the face of a scientific revolution is a lot of pressure, even for Jennifer Doudna, a legend in biology, who helped her in CRISPR into a breakthrough method for altering DNA,

subtitles.zh: 从遗传病到气候变化，她应对各种挑战，并在这个过程中催生了数十家公司。
subtitles.en: tackling everything from genetic disease to climate change, and spawning dozens of companies in the process.

subtitles.zh: 但一些批评者认为这项技术尚未达到宣传的效果，更不用说伦理问题了。
subtitles.en: But some critics claim the tech hasn't lived up to its hype just yet, not to mention the ethical concerns.

subtitles.zh: 与此同时，电影对生物技术的描绘对基因编辑来说并非好的公关。
subtitles.en: At the same time, movie depictions of biotechnology have been exactly been great PR for gene editing.

subtitles.zh: 比人类更人性化是我们的座右铭。我撒了多少谎并不重要。
subtitles.en: More human than human is our motto. It didn't matter how much I lied.

subtitles.zh: 我真正的简历在我的细胞里。
subtitles.en: My real resume was in my cells.
